svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.21.8 Portable Fire Extinguishers
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Each construction camp building is provided
In conformance with the appropriate provincial or
territorial regulations or municipal bylaws or,
in the absence of such regulations or bylaws, in
conformance with the British Columbia Fire Code.
Drawn: one extinguisher symbol per building, outside its door for visibility. Positions are examples.
Metric values quoted from the code · imperial in brackets converted · ACCESS Indigenous Skills4Success
